title: Lorne-Style Fresh Breakfast Sausage
description: Lorne-style breakfast sausages, a Scottish breakfast staple, are made with a tasty combination of spices--make this large batch to enjoy some now and freeze some for later.
ingredients: 1.5 teaspoons onion powder, or more to taste
1.25 teaspoons kosher salt, or more to taste
1.25 teaspoons ground black pepper, or more to taste
1.25 teaspoons ground coriander, or more to taste
0.5 teaspoon ground nutmeg, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon ground allspice, or more to taste

steps.text: Mix together ground beef, ground pork, bread crumbs, beef broth, brown sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder, 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt, 1 1/4 teaspoons pepper, 1 1/4 teaspoons coriander, 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg, and 1/4 teaspoon allspice in a large bowl until well combined. Shape some of the mixture into 2 or 3 small patties and place remaining sausage mixture in the refrigerator.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Add sausage patties and cook until browned and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes per side; do not overcook or sausages will be dry. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

Taste cooked sausages, adding more salt, pepper, and/or spices to the uncooked mixture as desired. Press uncooked sausage mixture into loaf pans and place in the refrigerator until firm, 2 to 3 hours.

Remove sausage "loaves" from the pans and slice into 1/2-inch slabs. Separate slabs with plastic wrap and store in the refrigerator if you will be cooking all sausage within 4 days. Cook as directed above, over medium-low heat.
